messages.content:
You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Ask ONE distinguishing question (offering the three options is best), confirm H-302 (2250 Main St, near Oak), transfer both.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
    (agent system action #2: verify_identity({"patient":"Jamal Carter","dob":"3/14/1995"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Jamal Carter","home_store":"B-4471","default_store":"B-4471","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #5: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Jamal Carter"}) -> success {"patient":"Jamal Carter","prescriptions":[]})
    (agent system action #7: find_stores({"query":"Harbor Main Lakeview"}) -> success {"stores":[{"store_id":"H-301","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Main St Downtown","address":"120 Main St, Lakeview, MI (near 1st Ave)"},{"store_id":"H-302","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Main St University","address":"2250 Main St, Lake...)
[#9] AGENT: I'll verify your identity and then help you transfer those prescriptions. Great, Jamal. Now let me pull up your prescriptions and find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview. I'm not seeing any active prescriptions on file for you at Brightway 4471. It's possible they haven't been transferred to our system yet, or they may have been filled recently and the records haven't synced. Which Harbor location on Main were you thinking of—the one downtown at 120 Main, the one near the university at 2250 Main, or the one in Northgate Mall?
CALLER: Near Oak, that's the one by my apartment.
[#12] AGENT: Perfect, that's Harbor Pharmacy Main St University at 2250 Main. Since your prescriptions aren't showing in our system yet, I'll need to request the transfer from Brightway. Can you confirm the prescription details—do you have the Rx numbers, or can you tell me the medication strengths for the albuterol and sertraline?
CALLER: Wait, near Oak is by University? I thought that was more like a different part of town, but okay if you say so. I don't got the Rx numbers on me, just know it's albuterol and sertraline, standard stuff.
[#15] AGENT: You're right to double-check—let me make sure we have the right store. The one near Oak Street is at 2250 Main St University, which is in the university area of Lakeview. Does that sound like it's near your apartment, or would one of the other locations work better for you?
CALLER: I mean, I don't know all the street names yet, I just moved here. Whichever one's actually near Oak, that's the one I need.
[#18] AGENT: I understand—I don't have the cross streets for the other two locations in front of me. Let me flag our pharmacist to confirm which Harbor store is actually near Oak Street, and they can help get your prescriptions transferred there once we know the right spot. What's the best number to reach you at?
CALLER: Yeah, it's the same number I'm calling from now. Just wanna make sure it goes to the right spot, I don't need my meds ending up across town.
    (agent system action #21: flag_pharmacist_callback({"patient":"Jamal Carter","reason":"Patient recently moved to Lakeview and needs albuterol and sertraline transferred from Brightway 4471 in Columbus. Needs confirmation of which Harbor Lakeview location is near Oak Street (patient's apartment area) before transfer. Prescriptions not yet visible in our system; may need to request from Brightway.","priority":"routine"}) -> success {"status":"flagged","patient":"Jamal Carter","priority":"routine"})
[#24] AGENT: I hear you. Let me flag the pharmacist to confirm the location near Oak Street and get your prescriptions transferred there. They'll call you back at this number to finalize it. All set. The pharmacist will call you back at this number to confirm the right location near Oak and handle the transfer of your albuterol and sertraline from Brightway. They should reach you soon.
CALLER: Alright, cool, appreciate it. Just make sure it's the right Harbor near Oak, not across town. Thanks.
[#27] AGENT: You got it—I've made a note that it needs to be the Harbor near Oak Street. The pharmacist will confirm the exact location and get those prescriptions moved there for you. Thanks for calling Harbor Pharmacy!
CALLER: Cool, appreciate it. Talk later.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S12.judged.1: Recognizes that three Harbor stores on Main St in Lakeview match.
S12.judged.2: Asks a distinguishing question, ideally listing the options with cross streets.
S12.judged.3: Confirms H-302 by address (2250 Main St, near Oak St) before transferring.
S12.judged.4: Asks Jamal to look up the store's address himself.
S12.judged.5: Asks more than two questions to settle the store.

JSON only.

{"S12.judged.1": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 9, "why": "Agent listed three Harbor locations (downtown, university, Northgate) as possible matches."},
"S12.judged.2": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 9, "why": "Agent asked which Harbor location, listing all three options with addresses."},
"S12.judged.3": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 24, "why": "Agent never confirmed H-302 address before transferring; instead flagged pharmacist due to uncertainty."},
"S12.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never asked caller to look up the address himself."},
"S12.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 15, "why": "Only two distinguishing questions were asked (#9 and #15), not more than two."}}
